mechanism: Foscarnet can cause electrolyte disturbances (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia) and tretinoin increases photosensitivity and potential for enhanced toxicity in immunocompromised patients; both drugs have teratogenic potential requiring careful monitoring.
action: Monitor electrolytes regularly during concurrent use, ensure adequate sun protection with tretinoin, assess renal function, and use only if benefits justify risks; both drugs require pregnancy prevention strategies in reproductive-age patients.
